GF48: forty-eight bits

You will learn

How the rule splits 48 bits into 1 + 18 + 29, a width IEEE 754 does not have.

GF48 has 48 bits: 1 sign, 18 exponent, 29 mantissa, bias 131071. IEEE 754 has no 48-bit format; the rule makes one the same way it makes all the others. Its ratio E / M is 0.621, 0.003 from 1 / phi.

Try it

Find BIAS and EXP_MAX in gf48.t27 and check them against 2^17 - 1 and 2^18 - 1. Then find the three shift constants and say which field each one places.
